title: Tenant managed execution authority and approval lifecycle

phases.objective: Prove code and additive schema contracts for capability-bound, resource-grant-bound, approval-gated, idempotent managed execution without applying the migration or performing an external operation.

e2e_journeys.actor: Authorized tenant requester and managed execution approver
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Managed execution service and workflow orchestration routes
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The linked task and run contain immutable authority evidence, approval cannot be bypassed, insufficient approver roles are rejected, authority drift blocks new steps, and repeated step requests remain idempotent.
steps: Validate explicit tenant, requester, parent ticket, capability, resource, effect, and idempotency scope.
Resolve active capability authority and effective resource grant.
Build a fingerprinted authority snapshot and derive approval policy.
Create or reuse the linked task, run, hold, binding, and event contract.
Verify approver role authority and revalidate live authority before a managed step.
Reject secret-bearing payloads, generic-route bypass, invalid transitions, and contradictory terminal states.
assertions: Missing or inactive capability authority fails closed.
Insufficient, revoked, expired, or changed resource authority fails closed.
Approval-required execution cannot create a managed step before an approved hold exists.
A principal below the hold required_role cannot decide the approval.
Repeated run and step requests reuse existing objects.
Migration 1043 is additive and contains no destructive table operation.
No provider call, credential read, external send, deployment, Production mutation, or SQL Apply occurs.

phases.objective: Apply Migration 1043 through a separately authorized governed migration and verify ledger and readiness evidence.
Complete bounded retry, cancellation, reassignment, rollback, and linked-state reconciliation.
Run tenant and admin canary paths against an exact deployed non-production candidate.
Verify exact Production SHA, migration ledger, protected tenant path, runtime readback, and post-merge audit before closing Issue 4449.
